```{r}
#| include: false

local({
  find_project_root <- function(start_dir) {
    current_dir <- normalizePath(start_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

    repeat {
      startup_file <- file.path(current_dir, "_exercise_startup.R")
      if (file.exists(startup_file)) return(current_dir)

      parent_dir <- dirname(current_dir)
      if (identical(parent_dir, current_dir)) {
        stop("Could not find _exercise_startup.R above the current exercise.")
      }

      current_dir <- parent_dir
    }
  }

  if (!isTRUE(getOption("QRA.exercise_startup_loaded"))) {
    project_root <- find_project_root(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))

    options(QRA.exercise_project_root = project_root)

    source(
      file.path(project_root, "_exercise_startup.R"),
      local = knitr::knit_global(),
      chdir = TRUE
    )

    options(QRA.exercise_startup_loaded = TRUE)
  }
})
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

read_exercise_metadata <- function(exercise_file) {
  lines <- readLines(exercise_file, warn = FALSE)
  if (length(lines) < 3 || lines[[1]] != "<!--") {
    return(list())
  }

  closing_delimiter <- which(lines[-1] == "-->")[1]
  if (is.na(closing_delimiter)) {
    return(list())
  }

  yaml::yaml.load(paste(lines[2:closing_delimiter], collapse = "\n"))
}

metadata <- read_exercise_metadata(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))

if (
  identical(metadata$status, "ready-to-use") &&
    metadata$mode %in% c("exercise", "drill")
) {
  cat(
    knitr::knit_child(
      file.path(getOption("QRA.exercise_project_root"), "_devoirs.qmd"),
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```
